coverage.historicalBalanceSampling: One state every 7200 Ethereum blocks; exact observed timestamps are supplied. These are balance snapshots, not daily transfer or trade totals.
coverage.selection: Largest estimated-USD token acquisitions within each provider latest <=300 trades sample, restricted to the named finalized cutoff. Size-biased selection, not a complete or representative sample.

method.decoding: Uniswap V3 Swap amount0/amount1 are signed int256 pool balance deltas. Exact integer values decoded from successful canonical transaction receipts, token0/token1/factory/decimals checked by fixed-block eth_call.
method.routing: Resolve acquisition only when ERC20 receipt transfers have exactly one token net source equal to the sampled pool, exactly one net receiver, and pool output equals decoded acquisition. Other cases stay ambiguous.
method.balances: balanceOf at named historical block heights. ~1D/~7D are actual block checkpoints with their measured timestamps, not inferred flow histories.
method.retention: No intervening complete transfer history is available. Later balance gives only [0,min(acquired,final balance)] retained-token bounds, not a proved retained purchase. Transfers, replacements, bridges, custody, bots and common ownership are not inferred.
method.quote: Trade quote is WETH native amount, not USD. Provider estimated USD is used only for selecting the investigation sample.
method.costBasis: Swap execution ratio is known; lifetime/holder-age cost basis and realized profit remain unavailable without full transfer and disposal history.
method.identity: Addresses may be contracts, routers, market makers or custodians. Beneficial owners and whales have not been identified.
